observations: Nikon DSLR camera body with a lens attached.
The lens is covered by a black lens cap.
The camera is being held by a person's hand.
A watermark 'STARSHOT IMAGE' is visible across the center of the image.
The background shows a white wall and a light switch.

claims.evidence: The model name is not legible in the photo.
The lens markings are not clearly legible in the photo.
The lens cap obscures the front glass and the body shows some wear.

risks.risk: The camera may not power on or the sensor may be dirty.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on and taking a clear photo.

risks.risk: The lens may have fungus, scratches, or internal defects.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the front and rear lens elements without the cap.

risks.risk: The shutter may be near the end of its life (high shutter count).
risks.proof: A screenshot of a shutter count utility showing the total actuations.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Clear photo of the model name on the camera body.
Clear photo of the lens markings (brand and focal length).
Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the lens glass without the cap.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
